passage.title: Reading 1 · Festivals in Four Seasons
passage.text: People in different places celebrate festivals in every season. In spring, a town may decorate its streets with flowers. In summer, people gather near a river and enjoy music. In autumn, a parade can take place after the harvest. In winter, families may wear special costumes and watch fireworks. These events are different, but they share one purpose: bringing people together. A festival is not only a show for visitors. It can also help a community remember its traditions and share them with younger people.

passage.title: Reading 2 · A Festival Team
passage.text: Our class decided to participate in a local festival. First, we set up a small booth and displayed a wooden puzzle. Then we invited visitors to try it. Some students wore traditional costumes, while others explained the rules. At the end of the day, we hardly had time to rest because so many people came. Surprisingly, the booth was popular even though it was simple. We learned that a festival becomes special when people work together and have fun.

passage.title: Reading 3 · A Festival Poster
passage.text: The poster for the Green Spring Festival shows a giant tree in the center. Around it, children are planting flowers and cleaning a park. The words 'Small actions matter' appear at the bottom. The poster does not show fireworks or a parade. Instead, it asks visitors to participate in activities that protect nature. The tree symbolizes the hope that the community can make the area greener. The organizers believe that visitors will remember the message when they take part themselves.

passage.title: Reading 4 · Choosing an Activity
passage.text: At the school festival, students could choose between a dance contest and a puzzle race. Jina wanted to join the dance contest because she enjoys music. Minho preferred the puzzle race because he likes solving problems. Their teacher said that it was important to respect different choices. In the end, both students participated in their favorite activities and helped decorate the hall. They discovered that having fun did not mean everyone had to choose the same thing.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: They have lived here for five years. What does this sentence mean?

They started living here five years ago and still live here.
They will live here for five years.
They have visited here five times.
They moved away five years ago.

The child asleep was on the sofa.
The child was asleep on the sofa.

The child was sleep on the sofa.

question.subject: 영어

I knew Mina for two years and still know her.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: What is the main idea of Reading 1?

options.option: Festivals bring people together and help share traditions.
Every festival has the same activities.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: According to Reading 1, what may people do in winter?

options.option: Take part in a harvest parade.

question.explanation: 겨울에는 가족들이 특별한 의상을 입고 불꽃놀이를 볼 수 있다고 했다.
question.advancedExplanation: 계절별 정보를 연결해 확인한다. 봄은 꽃, 여름은 강가 음악, 가을은 수확 후 퍼레이드, 겨울은 의상과 불꽃놀이다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: What does 'them' refer to in Reading 1?
question.explanation: them은 앞에서 언급한 traditions(전통)를 가리킨다.
question.advancedExplanation: 대명사의 지시 대상은 문장 의미와 수·의미 관계를 확인해 판단한다.

options.option: Festivals can take place in different seasons.
A festival may help a community remember traditions.
Every festival is only a show for visitors.
People may share traditions with younger people.

question.explanation: 글은 축제가 방문객을 위한 공연만은 아니라고 명시한다.
question.advancedExplanation: not / only와 같은 부정 표현을 놓치지 말고 본문 주장과 대조한다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: Choose the best title for Reading 1.
question.explanation: 계절별 활동은 다르지만 사람들을 모으고 전통을 나눈다는 공통 목적이 중심이다.
question.advancedExplanation: 제목은 특정 세부 활동보다 글 전체의 핵심 내용을 포괄해야 한다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: What did the class do first in Reading 2?

options.option: They set up a booth and displayed a puzzle.

question.explanation: 먼저 부스를 설치하고 나무 퍼즐을 전시했다.
question.advancedExplanation: First, Then, At the end of와 같은 순서 표현을 이용해 사건 순서를 확인한다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: Why was the booth popular?

options.option: It was simple but students worked together and welcomed visitors.

question.explanation: 글은 단순했지만 많은 방문객이 왔고 협력과 참여가 이루어졌다고 설명한다.
question.advancedExplanation: 인기를 얻은 이유를 규모나 비용으로 단정하지 않는다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: What does 'hardly had time to rest' mean?

options.option: They rested for a long time.
They had almost no time to rest.
They did not come to the festival.

question.explanation: hardly는 ‘거의 ~않다’라는 뜻이므로 쉴 시간이 거의 없었다.
question.advancedExplanation: hardly를 hard(열심히)와 혼동하지 않는다. 문맥에서 부정에 가까운 의미를 갖는다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: Which activity was NOT mentioned in Reading 2?
question.explanation: Reading 2에는 불꽃놀이를 보았다는 내용이 없다.
question.advancedExplanation: 본문에 등장한 활동을 확인하는 문제이므로 상식으로 내용을 보충하지 않는다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: What lesson did the students learn?

options.option: Working together and having fun can make a simple booth special.

question.explanation: 학생들은 협력과 즐거움이 단순한 부스도 특별하게 만들 수 있음을 배웠다.
question.advancedExplanation: 마지막 문장은 경험에서 얻은 교훈을 직접 제시한다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: What is the poster mainly asking visitors to do?
question.explanation: 포스터는 자연을 보호하는 활동에 참여하도록 권한다.
question.advancedExplanation: Green Spring Festival, Small actions matter, 나무·꽃 심기 그림을 종합해 중심 메시지를 판단한다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: What does the giant tree symbolize?

options.option: The community's hope for a greener area

question.explanation: 나무는 지역을 더 푸르게 만들 수 있다는 공동체의 희망을 상징한다.
question.advancedExplanation: symbolize는 실제 사물과 추상적 의미의 관계를 나타낸다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: Why does the poster not show fireworks or a parade?

options.option: It focuses on environmental participation instead.
The organizers forgot to add pictures.
The event is only for children.

question.explanation: 포스터는 자연 보호 활동 참여를 강조하므로 불꽃놀이·퍼레이드 대신 환경 활동을 보여 준다.
question.advancedExplanation: 자료의 선택과 배제는 제작자의 전달 의도와 연결된다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: Which phrase best supports the poster's message?
question.explanation: ‘Small actions matter’가 환경 보호를 위한 작은 실천의 중요성을 직접 전달한다.
question.advancedExplanation: 글과 시각 자료가 같은 메시지를 강화하는지 살핀다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: What can be inferred about the organizers?

options.option: They want visitors to participate, not just watch.
They want to remove all trees.

question.explanation: 활동 참여를 권하는 문구와 그림에서 관람보다 참여를 유도한다고 추론할 수 있다.
question.advancedExplanation: 추론은 본문 근거를 바탕으로 하며 글에 없는 극단적 주장을 선택하지 않는다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: Why did Jina want to join the dance contest?

options.option: She wanted to decorate the hall alone.
She was afraid of the race.

question.explanation: Jina는 음악을 즐기기 때문에 춤 경연을 원했다.
question.advancedExplanation: because 뒤의 이유와 인물의 선호를 연결한다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: Why did Minho prefer the puzzle race?

options.option: He wanted to wear a costume.

question.explanation: Minho는 문제 해결을 좋아하기 때문에 퍼즐 경주를 선호했다.
question.advancedExplanation: Jina와 Minho의 선택·이유를 서로 바꾸지 않는다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: What does the teacher mean by 'respect different choices'?

Students should accept that classmates may prefer different things.
The puzzle race should be canceled.

question.explanation: 서로 다른 선호를 인정하고 존중하라는 뜻이다.
question.advancedExplanation: respect는 다른 선택을 존중한다는 의미로 쓰인다.

question.subject: 영어
question.prompt: What did both students do in the end?
